payload.final_answer: The game you are looking for is "Doom," developed by id Software, which was originally established as "Softdisk Publishing" in the early 1990s. The game was released in November 1993 for DOS, features a single-player mode, and follows a shareware business model. The three credited individuals include John Carmack and John Romero, who share the same last name.
